_about: The default deck theme for RAPP install packets, in Microsoft Fluent. This file is DATA: a generator reads it at runtime and renders to it. To brand every deck as your own, copy it into any repo — public, or PRIVATE with contributors approved — change what you care about, and point DECK_DOGG_URL at your raw URL. No code change, no rebuild, no redeploy. Anything you omit falls back to these values, so four brand colours is already a complete theme.

_fields.brand: wordmark, foot_left, bar — the strip, footer and title mark
_fields.palette: hex colours without '#'; ink, paper, accent, muted, rule are required, the rest optional
_fields.slides: the slide plan itself; a slide whose source is empty is SKIPPED and named in the packet manifest, never faked
_fields.type: font names and point sizes as strings (the canonical form forbids floats)

_private_themes: A theme may live in a private repo: globally addressable, readable only by approved contributors. raw.githubusercontent returns 404 — not 403 — to everyone else, so 'not approved' and 'does not exist' look identical. A generator must therefore NEVER silently fall back from a private theme to this default: someone whose access was revoked would keep producing generic decks believing they were branded. Pass private=true and set a token in RAPP_DOGG_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN; on refusal, no packet is written.
name: Microsoft Fluent (RAPP default)

voice.avoid: claims the agent's own contract does not support
voice.tone: plain and specific; state what the agent does and does not do
